name: TC-AN-QB-003 — 批量填写：合法JSON全部导入成功 [P0]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开，已选参与人区域可编辑
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击编辑进入节点编辑页

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写') || (b.textContent || '').includes('批量导入')); if (!batchBtn) return { clicked: false, error: '未找到批量填写按钮' }; batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, btnText: batchBtn.textContent.trim() }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); if (!modal) return { found: false, error: '弹窗未出现' }; const textarea = modal.querySelector('textarea, .ant-input'); if (!textarea) return { found: false, error: '弹窗内无输入框' }; const validJson = JSON.stringify([{empId:'421225',empName:'宗育'},{empId:'320729',empName:'澜蓝'}]); const nativeInputValueSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; nativeInputValueSetter.call(textarea, validJson); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return { found: true, inputted: validJson }; })()
steps.description: 在弹窗内粘贴合法JSON数组

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); if (!modal) return { clicked: false }; const confirmBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('确认导入') || (b.textContent || '').includes('确认') || (b.textContent || '').includes('确定')); if (!confirmBtn) return { clicked: false, error: '未找到确认按钮' }; confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const toasts = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice, .ant-notification-notice'); const toastTexts = Array.from(toasts).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasResult = toastTexts.some(t => t.includes('总计') && t.includes('成功')); const modalClosed = !document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not([style*=display\\:\\ none]), .ant-drawer:not([style*=display\\:\\ none])'); return { toasts: toastTexts, hasResult, modalClosed }; })()
steps.description: 验证toast统计信息和弹窗关闭

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开，已选参与人区域可编辑
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 点击「批量填写」按钮\n2. 弹窗内粘贴合法JSON: [{empId:'421225',empName:'宗育'},{empId:'320729',empName:'澜蓝'}]\n3. 点击「确认导入」
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 校验通过，弹窗关闭，输入框清空\n2. 合法项与已有参与人合并去重写入表单\n3. toast展示10秒:「总计 N 条，成功 N 条，实际新增 M 位」
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
